title: THE BUSY FRAME HAS NO OVERLAPS
why: The HUD spec of 2026-10-15 and his order, "the whole game just needs ui clean up": a check of a busy frame, at 1920x1080 and 3840x2160, alone and with a teammate, which asks every HUD piece where it drew and fails on any two that share a pixel and on any text cut by the screen. It found four. The compact controls list stood under the item in hand plate, the extraction lines and the power-up chips; the extraction lines stood through the power-up chips; the item in hand plate kept its 1080p size at 4K; and a line sliding into the feed was measured off the screen.
now: The controls list, the extraction lines and the item in hand now stand clear of each other and of the power-up chips, and the item in hand plate grows with the screen.
